title: Household
description: A party of guests invited together to one wedding (issue #27): a couple, a family, a single guest. Owned by one tenant and one wedding; stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, household_id) and read one wedding at a time. A household is the unit an RSVP link is sent to (M2).

household_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

wedding_id.description: The wedding the household is invited to (verified to exist in the tenant at creation).

name.description: The party's name as the couple addresses it, e.g. 'The Rivera family'.

address.description: Optional mailing address (free text). Personal data: never logged, shown only to the wedding's planner and couple.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.
